story-063.title: Drop buffer sanity band from PostMigrationCleanup (YS-10); log-only diagnostics
removed: the [dolaSkimmed/2, dolaSkimmed*2] REQUIRE at verify 4b (Verify 4b FAILED: DOLA buffer not within sanity band)
bool dolaSkimRecorded / usdcSkimRecorded tracking vars (no longer needed)
story-063.retained: the HARD solvency invariant require(dolaP >= dolaTotalStaked) / require(usdcP >= usdcTotalStaked) at 4b/5b [PostMigrationCleanup.s.sol:223-224]. dolaSkimmed/usdcSkimmed are now read for diagnostic logs ONLY [225-230].
story-063.rationale: buffer = skim + realize-over-credit surplus, surplus dominating (on fork USDC buffer ~51x skim). The old band falsely assumed buffer ~= skim and would REVERT valid migrated state before the minter-revocation mutation could run.
story-063.onChainDelta: NONE — story-063 removes a REVERT GATE (a require), not a mutation. Net effect: cleanup is strictly LESS likely to false-revert; no new write, no removed write. The remaining solvency require is the real safety property.
story-063.auditFocus: Confirm removing the band cannot now let a genuinely-misaccounted (but still principal>=totalStaked) buffer pass silently. The solvency invariant catches under-collateralization; an OVER-large buffer (e.g. an accidental extra deposit / wrong-token sweep) would no longer trip a band — is that a real risk or just expected surplus? (run-12 economic context: surplus is protocol-owned yield, benign.)

ys04_offByOne.status: STILL LIVE — gather-migration-inputs.js UNCHANGED since story-060 (last touched 23a24c6; zero diff b27c6ac..e935a05).
ys04_offByOne.mechanism: on-chain getStakersRange(token,start,end) is half-open [start,end) (iterates i=start; i<end; clamps end to len; NatSpec StableStaker.sol:663). JS caller [gather lines 271-284]: end = Math.min(start+PAGE_SIZE, countNum) - 1; getStakersRange(token, start, end); start = end + 1. The JS treats end as INCLUSIVE while the contract treats it as EXCLUSIVE, so each page fetches indices [start..end-1] (DROPS index `end`) and then start jumps to end+1, permanently skipping index `end`. The final boundary also drops the last staker (end clamps, last index never read).
ys04_offByOne.selfDefenseInteraction: gather writes JSON .count = allStakers.length (the UNDERCOUNT). forge leg1/leg2 preflight requires JSON .count == on-chain stakerCount(token). On any drop, JSON.count < on-chain count => preflight REVERTS ('stale ... staker count - re-run gather'). So at e935a05 the bug surfaces as a HARD preflight DoS / unbreakable re-run loop for any non-empty pool (single page <= 200: last staker always dropped), NOT silent staker loss. script-auditor: re-confirm severity under this gating (availability/DoS, not value-loss / not partial migration).
